title: Africa–Asia platinum exports
note: Platinum, unwrought or in powder form (HS 711011), and platinum in other semi-manufactured forms (HS 711019). The two codes are stored separately and must not be added. Reporter exports to the other region only. Values under USD 1 million are omitted. A missing pair is not zero trade. A missing code or year is not zero and must not be filled from the other platinum code or from another year. Customs weight is kilograms, not troy ounces, and is not the London or spot platinum price. Net weight and quantity can both be kilograms and still differ; they must not be substituted. A null net weight is not zero. Quantity 0 with unit code -1 is not a measured kilogram weight. This is not the HS 7110 heading, which also includes palladium, rhodium, iridium, osmium, and ruthenium. Palladium is stored separately as HS 711021 and HS 711029 and must not be added to these platinum codes. Rhodium (HS 711031 and HS 711039) and iridium, osmium, and ruthenium (HS 711041 and HS 711049) are not stored. This is not precious-metal ores (HS 2616), not waste and scrap (HS 7112), not jewelry (HS 7113), and not gold (HS 7108). Mine production is absent from this database, not zero. The Pink Sheet benchmark stored with this trade is platinum, 99.95% minimum purity, plate or ingot form, spot average of daily rates from June 2025, and previously UK 99.9% refined London afternoon fixing, in US dollars per troy ounce. It is not gold, not silver, not palladium, and not the customs unit value. Silver is not stored. The Pink Sheet has no palladium or rhodium series.
